craft_notes: Sthāyin: definition-by-negation (dhyāna stated in positives, refused to imagery in the second line). Rows: row 1 (definition whole — positives uncut). Close: imagining (the refused word closes: the no lands last, line-final). Rejected: 'visualization' — killed: imagining kept (kalpanā as making, not seeing); splitting the body-list — killed: body-eye-mouth-hand kept whole (the list IS the refusal).
